task: verify realised scenario exposure in the SHK and DET dev runs (EVT + CONV twin)

inferred_columns.proxy_truth.q: citypulse/sim.py:read_detectors -- 'vehicles in the previous completed 30 s interval' summed over the detector's lanes, so the row at tick t covers [t-30, t); v is the count-weighted mean speed (km/h, NaN when q=0), o the mean lane occupancy (%).
inferred_columns.proxy_halting.ktb_w3|ktb_n1: TraCI edge.getLastStepHaltingNumber, sampled on the same 30 s ticks; halting_sum = ktb_w3 + ktb_n1.
inferred_columns.twin_log.obs_*: the SensorMsg reading as the Twin received it (Proxy truth passed through SensorEmulator, including any --sensor-fault); twin_* is the Twin's own state.
inferred_columns.trigger_log.B: event.bottleneck_index; NaN means the interval was missing (obs invalid / null occupancy / null twin reading / no sigma). The logged frame drops the 'why' reason and the residual terms, so both are recomputed here from twin_log + sigma_event.json.
inferred_columns.rou.xml vehicle@depart: scheduled departure time of the Proxy demand; SUMO may insert later when the entry is congested, so this is the *scheduled* shock and proxy_truth.q is the realised passage.

residual_reconstruction_validation.note: Recomputed B equals trigger_log.parquet B at every tick of the 18 SHK/DET/NOI EVT runs (downweight empty), so the residual decomposition above is exact for them. The INC runs are excluded: they set event.downweight = 5.0 on both pair detectors once the fault hypothesis is adopted, which shrinks the logged B by 5x.

SHK.verdict: injected, no bottleneck signature (trigger limitation at this magnitude)

evidence.routes_file: proxy_shock.rou.xml in all 6 EVT and 6 CONV run_info.json

SHK.note: The +30 % demand shock is present in the route file the Proxy loaded (scheduled UPPER departures +29.1 % in [4500, 5400)), but the realised flow past the corridor entry (AID07105 on tko_in) and the upper branch (AID02105 on ktb_w1) rises only ~+5-7 %: the shared entry is already at capacity in the paired NOI control (2784-2820 veh/h vs 2932-3000 veh/h under the shock, i.e. ~+5 %), so the extra vehicles queue and are released over the following ~30 min (the SHK-NOI gap at AID07105 stays positive to 7200 and the full-run totals converge on the scheduled totals: +91 realised vs +74 scheduled). No halting appears on ktb_n1/ktb_w3 (max 0 in all 6 seeds, against 74-143 in the INC runs) and B never reaches 3 at two consecutive ticks, so the trigger was never exposed to a +30 % shock at the detectors. In 3 of 6 seeds there are isolated single-tick B >= 3 excursions (max 3.27); the NOI control has the same kind of excursion (up to 4.08 in seed 4401) and the trigger requires two consecutive ticks, so these are not a bottleneck signature.

DET.verdict: injected, no bottleneck signature (trigger limitation at this magnitude)

evidence.sensor_fault: AID02109:stuck:4500:5400 in all 6 EVT and 6 CONV run_info.json

DET.note: The fault is realised exactly as specified (constant, valid, equal to the last valid pre-4500 reading, while the paired NOI run varies), and it is applied to emitted observations only (Proxy truth at AID02109 still varies). The frozen reading is a plausible value, so the fault does not dominate the residual: the mean r_U^o over the window is within +-0.7 sigma_o in every seed, and the single-tick extremes (|r_U^o| = 1.6-3.3) are inside the paired NOI control's own range (2.1-3.4) on the same detector. B is half the *difference* of the two detectors' occupancy residuals plus a speed term whose stuck component has the opposite sign, so B never reaches 3 at two consecutive ticks. The sensor fault therefore does not create a bottleneck signature the corrected G4 rule could see.

INC_reference.note: The INC EVT runs show B up to 16.3, 5-11 ticks with B >= 3, streaks of 3-7 consecutive ticks and 2-6 alarms; the same code path does fire when a real bottleneck exists. Their trigger_log B is computed with event.downweight = 5.0 on both pair detectors once the fault hypothesis is adopted, so the logged B after adoption is 5x smaller than the raw residuals.

NOI_reference.note: NOI EVT runs are the false-alarm control: 0-1 isolated ticks with B >= 3 (up to 4.08), never two consecutive, no alarm.
